LanguageData.LP_OfferSoul.label: drained a soul
LanguageData.LP_OfferSoul.description: Consume a complete humanlike corpse and draw its soul into the phylactery. Sacrifice XP gained = (50 + 5 × total skill levels) × psychic sensitivity (counted between 20% and 400%). The corpse must not be missing any body part, must not be a desiccated skeleton, and must not be a lich or necromantic construct. Select a corpse to see its soul value.
